title: Fetch funder address tags so service-funder suppression fires on non-holder funders
objective: Close SOL-WALLET-CLEANING-AUDIT-003 FIND-1: address tags are only fetched for holder/owner addresses, so a non-holder exchange hot wallet funder is never tagged and service-funder suppression silently never fires, wrongly excluding exchange fan-outs as same-source clusters. Fetch tags for funding-edge funder addresses in both the generic and snapshot-aligned passes, fix the exclusion warning to count only members actually used for exclusion, and add differential tests including the 0.8/0.79 suppression boundary and a non-holder funder scenario.
forbidden_actions: Do not lower any confidence threshold or widen SERVICE_FUNDER_ROLES.
Do not modify src/domain/rules/real-holders.ts or holder snapshot services.
Do not use network APIs, credentials or live providers.
